# Dear ImGui Vendor Receipt

Source: https://github.com/ocornut/imgui

Pinned release: `v1.92.8`

Pinned commit: `8936b58fe26e8c3da834b8f60b06511d537b4c63`

The BGE U0 adapter compiles the Dear ImGui core sources plus the official
Win32, DirectX 11, and DirectX 12 backend sources from this directory. The
upstream license is retained as `LICENSE.txt`.
